import { Controller, Inject, Injectable, Post } from '@nestjs/common';
import { CACHE_MANAGER } from '@nestjs/cache-manager';
import type { Cache } from 'cache-manager';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Column, Entity, PrimaryGeneratedColumn, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import Redlock from 'redlock';

const ORDER_LOCKS = ['locks:orders'] as const;

@Entity('audit_log')
class AuditLog {
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
  id!: number;

  @Column()
  action!: string;
}

@Injectable()
class AuditService {
  constructor(@InjectRepository(AuditLog) private readonly audit: Repository<AuditLog>) {}

  async record(action: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.audit.save({ action });
  }
}

@Injectable()
class OrderService {
  constructor(
    private readonly redlock: Redlock,
    @Inject(CACHE_MANAGER) private readonly cache: Cache,
    private readonly audit: AuditService,
  ) {}

  async place(orderId: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.redlock.using(
      [`locks:order:${orderId}`, 'locks:orders'],
      5_000,
      async () => {
        await this.cache.set(`order:${orderId}`, { privatePayload: 'must-not-be-retained' });
        await this.audit.record('placed');
      },
    );
  }

  async reconcile(): Promise<void> {
    await this.redlock.using(ORDER_LOCKS, 10_000, { retryCount: 2 }, async function () {
      await Promise.resolve();
    });
  }

  async outsideLock(): Promise<void> {
    await this.audit.record('ordinary');
  }

  async dynamic(resources: string[]): Promise<void> {
    await this.redlock.using(resources, 5_000, async () => {
      await this.audit.record('dynamic');
    });
  }

  private readonly callback = async (): Promise<void> => this.audit.record('method-reference');

  async unsupportedCallback(): Promise<void> {
    await this.redlock.using(ORDER_LOCKS, 5_000, this.callback);
  }
}

class RedlockLookalike {
  using(resources: readonly string[], duration: number, callback: () => Promise<void>) {
    return callback();
  }
}

@Injectable()
class LookalikeService {
  constructor(private readonly redlock: RedlockLookalike) {}

  async ignored(): Promise<void> {
    await this.redlock.using(['lookalike'], 1, async () => undefined);
  }
}

@Controller('orders')
class OrdersController {
  constructor(private readonly orders: OrderService) {}

  @Post(':id')
  place(): Promise<void> {
    return this.orders.place('runtime-id');
  }
}
